title: Trump, Xi and Putin Shake Hands as Leaders Gather in China
summary_full: China’s leader, Xi Jinping, earlier hugged President Trump on the tarmac as he arrived for a regional summit in Shenzhen. They are expected to hold a trilateral meeting on Thursday with President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.
